n1.text: Why the previous rounds read flat: a seven-unit step between near-black greys is about 3 L* and the eye needs 4 to 5 to see a level without a line. Drawing the line back in made it look outlined. So: a darker frame, nine-unit steps, highlight on the top edge instead of a border, and a slight cool bias so the greys are not dead.

n10.text: Round 3. Reading: body 14.3 / 23 with 12 between paragraphs, headings with their own air, quote as a 2 px rule, image as a Raised block with its caption inside; content is a new fixture of real project prose (fixtures/msp/synthetic-reading.jsonl). Composer: the chip row for attachments (image thumbnail or file glyph + name + meta, ✕), uploading and failed states, the drop ring, the @ and / menus at Floating, the queued row, running with stop. More cards: plan, summary, search, web, browser, delegated, MCP, your own $ command, skill loaded, markers, needs-you banner, streaming caret and shimmer, the hand-off as a marker row (no card: the confirm dialog already lists what crosses over), unknown kind, the empty session. Everything from the app's captures or the library's own sample data.

n11.text: Round 4. Approval pending as a screen: the warning ring, the command on the Well, the needs-you dot in the sidebar, the status row and stop. Error: the model-error card with its danger ring and one Retry, then the retry status row. Several questions: a wizard, one question at a time in one card. Header: the topic semibold, why in caption, '2 of 4' faint and the auto-resolve tag; a 3 px progress bar under it; then only the current question (header caption, question semibold, its options, Other when allowed). Footer: Back on the left with the keys, then Skip, Explain instead and Next (Continue on the last). Answering advances on its own after a single choice; pick-all waits for Next. The answered ones settle into one quiet row per question once the card closes.

n12.text: Round 5. The four composer pickers on the one dropdown (Floating, r 10, the edge + float drop, 6 px padding so the row highlight never touches the panel's edge; rows r 6, selected 9 % + semibold + check): provider rows as mark + name only (another provider on a session with turns opens the hand-off confirm; hand-off also sits in the ⋯ menu), models with context in faint mono and 9 % badges, effort with its nine meanings, approval mode with four. Nested: a submenu opens inside the menu's box 4 px to the right of its row. Effort as a slider: 4 px track, 8 ticks, 16 px thumb, name + meaning above, Default kept as a row. Send / stop: the composer's only solid fill — foreground when a draft, attachment or queued line exists and while running (stop square), muted at Floating when empty. Applied to every screen with a draft or a running turn.

n2.text: FINAL (owner, 2026-10-12): the cool-neutral ladder, light edge (7 % top highlight + 6 % white ring on every surface), floating drop 8/24 at 40 %, dialog drop 24/56 at 50 %. Only two kinds of depth exist: a surface that sits in another (fill + top highlight) and a surface that floats (a faint ring + one soft drop). FF's stacked small drops at 18 % are replaced by one diffuse drop; FF's structure (substrate + offset, surface-relative overlays, the springs) stays.

n3.text: A is used on the screens. The chips lose their borders; the composer card is the single edge at the bottom of the sheet. Provider stays visible as a mark, model and mode as text controls that light on hover.

n4.text: Revised 2026-10-13 (owner round 7): the sidebar column full height on the frame with its chrome row on top — lights (12,16), Hide/Show sidebar at x 84, the switch ending 12 before the column's edge; the sheet 6 px in with its own 32 px title row (title at 16, actions right) on the lights' line over a 64 px fade, like Claude Desktop — no app-wide header in either mode. Closed: only the column leaves (ease-out 260 / 220 ms, the sheet's content laid out once) and NOTHING stays — no row, no toggle, not even the traffic lights (hidden with the column). A 150 ms rest on the window's top edge (the 6 px frame band above the sheet) or its left edge peeks the whole sidebar as the frame-coloured column flush with the window's left, top and bottom, rounded 8 at the bottom right with a drop to its right, its own row (lights · toggle · switch) riding in with it; after a toggle the peek waits for the pointer to leave and come back. Depth: the sheet's contact shadow beside the open sidebar (black 16 % → 0 over 20 px); rows fade under the row (24 px).

n5.text: Browse: the page is the sheet, white on the frame. The address and the page controls live in the sidebar's own header, open or peeked. Closed (owner round 7): nothing sits over the page — the sheet is the whole window less the 6 px frame; the top or left edge peeks the sidebar with the address, the tabs and the controls over the page. No tab strip. The peek over the native page is a hole cut through the page window (holes add up, so an overlap never flips back).

n6.text: Polish pass 2026-10-12 (rhythm per FF), approved: one edge on every surface, the send button and the switch segment included (no private drops; the switch track is the 5 % overlay). Weights only 400 / 600: titles are 600. The open title row is centred on the lights' line (y 22), title 16 in, mirroring the action glyphs. The composer sits on the transcript's 880 measure (flush with the code block and table), FF InputMessage padding (8 around, text at 16, 4 between field and controls), 18 from the window bottom. Browse open uses the same drawn chrome and account footer as Sessions.

n7.text: D4 rules (proposed, 2026-10-13). Inside the sheet only Raised, Raised-lit and the Well, with the one edge; blocks and cards take radius 8 (the sheet's own), the user turn keeps 12 like the composer. Rows that only report — Worked for…, Thought…, Allowed, Answered, the live activity row — carry no surface: a 32 px quiet row, chevron left, muted text, the 5 % overlay on hover. A card that needs you (approval, question, failure) swaps the white ring for a 70 % ring in its status colour; nothing else is marked. Shell output and commands sit on the Well; a diff on Raised with 10 % line tints. Text is the FF roles at the app's 1.1 scale (body 14.3 / 22, caption 13.2 / 18, title 17.6 / 24, mono 12.65 / 20); spacing is unscaled. No standing actions anywhere: a hovered turn shows copy (and edit on yours) with its meta; code blocks show copy on hover; tool cards have no buttons; cards carry only the choices the provider minted. Content is lifted from the fixture captures, nothing invented.

n8.text: The four screens, one fixture each: Answer = synthetic-markdown (heading, bullets, inline code, code block, table, links, the turn's rail and footer, the seam under the composer: a 32 px fade above it, content runs under). Work = synthetic-toolgroup with the fold open (tool group, thinking row, read group, a resolved approval row, a failed shell card) and the next turn folded. Question = synthetic-question-error (the ring, the auto-resolve tag, the status row above the composer, stop in the composer, the needs-you dot in the sidebar). Goal + tasks = synthetic-todo-goal.

n9.text: Homes for the three controls (owner's placements, docs/40 §3). Toast chip and feedback slot: a corner stack 12 px from the sheet's right, newest toast above the slot, 8 apart; in Sessions the stack sits 8 above the composer's top edge, in Browse 12 above the sheet's bottom — an overlay window over the native page. Both are Floating with the edge and the float drop. Downloads: a 28 px icon button in the Browse sidebar's control row before ✦ and ⋯, a 6 px dot while a download runs, present only while downloads list; its list is the menu. Open for you: (1) quiet rows instead of cards for Worked / Thought / resolved; (2) radius 8 on blocks; (3) the status-colour ring on cards that need you; (4) actions only on hover, and only copy / edit; (5) the corner-stack rule.
